Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.draft: Draft – to be reviewed by a lawyer under Vietnam’s Personal Data Protection Law 91/2025/QH15 before public launch.

collect.p: Email, display name, year of birth (16+ check), time zone, learning progress and exercise results. No voice recordings are stored.

purposes.p: Saving progress, streaks and lesson suggestions. Every other purpose (analytics, email, AI, speech) needs separate consent you can withdraw on the Me page.

processors.p: Vercel (hosting), Neon (database), Cloudflare (storage). When enabled: AI providers, Google (browser speech recognition), PostHog (analytics), Resend (email).

transfer.p: Servers are in Singapore. Data is transferred and processed outside Vietnam under a transfer impact assessment.

age.p: Only people aged 16+ can create an account. Younger learners can still use the public content.

rights.p: Download all your data, withdraw consent or delete your account at any time on the Me page.
